conceptZh: 綠色小外星人開著飛碟追逐溜走的軍帽，牽引光束卻捲起自己的飛碟，害它飛撲撲空、肚皮撞地，把帽子震成排出「兵」的六筆，最後戴著剩下的帽頂敬禮。
object: A small green cartoon alien in a toy flying saucer and one runaway spring-brimmed toy soldier cap.
morph: The belly-flop jars six blue strips out of the cap’s spring brim. They skid into 兵 while the soft khaki crown flips onto the alien’s head.
creativeAngle: 軍帽靠彈簧帽沿一蹦一蹦地逃跑，牽引光束反捲飛碟，讓追逐自然升級成飛撲；帽沿散成六筆，留下的帽頂則讓外星人當場扮成小兵。
promptEn:
Create an exactly 8-second animated toy slapstick clip in one locked, straight-on wide shot. Use a pale apricot backdrop and a low matte runway. The lead is an original small green cartoon alien with rubbery antennae, a smug grin and an open toy flying saucer. Its prize is a khaki toy soldier cap with a thick cobalt spring brim. Reserve the center for 兵 and keep the payoff action at screen right.

0.0–1.4 s. The alien spots the cap, points at its own bare head and lunges for it. The spring brim compresses against the runway and kicks the cap sideways. It zips around a tight bend as the saucer skids after it, the alien still reaching with both hands.

1.4–3.2 s. The cap takes a wider loop. The alien fires its tractor beam and lifts a loose end of the brim just long enough for it to spring free. As the saucer banks hard, the beam curls under and grabs its own landing skid, yanking the saucer nose-up. The alien braces both feet on the cockpit rim, spots the cap crossing center again and pushes off in one eager flying leap.

3.2–5.0 s. The alien almost hugs the cap midair, then belly-flops onto its spring brim with one soft BONK. At about 3.7 s, the first spoken 兵 lands as six cobalt strips skid out of the brim into the center display plane. The rebound scoots the alien to screen right and flips the soft cap crown after it. At about 4.7 s, the second 兵 lands as the last strips slide to a stop in the exact standard six-stroke form of 兵. Match a standard printed glyph: short left-falling top stroke, left vertical, short inner horizontal, inner vertical, long baseline and two separate outward-falling feet. Keep the finished glyph flat, solid cobalt, centered and uncropped at about 70% of frame height, with clear margins.

5.0–8.0 s. Hold 兵 perfectly still for all three seconds. As 小兵 is spoken around 5.9 s, the cap crown lands squarely on the alien's head and it pops to attention with a proud toy-soldier salute. Its knees wobble once, then it grins, clear of the glyph throughout.

A warm off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin, slowly and distinctly, with a short pause between utterances. Read exactly “兵、兵、小兵” (ㄅㄧㄥ、ㄅㄧㄥ、ㄒㄧㄠˇ ㄅㄧㄥ), then stop. Keep the soft cartoon effects below the voice. Show only 兵 as text, with no subtitles, watermark or flashing effects.

conceptZh: 太空人玩偶和小外星人揮著泡棉手套比試，雙雙揮空轉圈、頭盔相撞，把飛出去的七塊泡棉撞成「兵」，最後敬禮握手。
object: A bouncy astronaut action figure with a fishbowl helmet, a green cartoon alien in an open toy saucer, and their two breakaway foam mitts.
morph: The helmet bump shakes three cobalt stroke pieces from the astronaut’s mitt and four from the alien’s. The seven pieces slide into a flat, front-facing 兵.
creativeAngle: 改用低重力泡棉比試，太空人一蹬就飄高，飛碟的牽引光束又拉到自己的底座，讓兩個揮空的對手轉回來撞在一起；用兩位原創玩具小士兵的同步敬禮呈現「小小兵」，字形按正楷七筆安排。
promptEn:
Create an exactly 8-second animated toy slapstick clip in one locked, straight-on wide shot. Use a pale peach backdrop and simple matte floor. An original astronaut action figure with chunky molded joints, a clear fishbowl helmet and an overconfident grin faces a small green cartoon alien in an open toy saucer. Both wear matching plain khaki toy uniforms and clear bubble helmets. Each holds one oversized cobalt foam mitt made of fitted breakaway pieces. Keep the center clear for 兵.

0.0–1.4 s. The astronaut points at the alien’s mitt, pats its own mitt twice and digs in its springy boots for a friendly foam-mitt duel. The alien grins and cocks its mitt way back as the saucer tilts in anticipation.

1.4–3.2 s. Both wind up and swing. The astronaut pushes off too hard and floats above the alien’s mitt just as the saucer’s tractor beam hooks its own landing skid and tips the alien below the astronaut’s swing. Both miss cleanly and spin from the follow-through, coming full circle face to face.

3.2–5.0 s. Give them one wide-eyed beat before their bubble helmets meet with a soft BOINK. Both drop into seated poses on opposite sides, wobbling with dazed grins. At about 3.6 s, on the first spoken 兵, the impact shakes three pieces out of one mitt and four from the other, sending all seven skidding inward. On the second 兵 at about 4.8 s, the pieces come flush into the exact printed Traditional Chinese 兵. Match its seven strokes: a short left-falling crown, a left upright, a short upper crossbar, an inner upright, a long lower crossbar and two separate outward-falling feet. The pieces sit flat in a front-facing plane and read as solid saturated cobalt.

5.0–8.0 s. Hold the finished 兵 perfectly still, centered and uncropped at about 70% of frame height with clear margins. As 小小兵 is spoken around 5.8 s, the saucer settles beside the astronaut at the lower right and both tiny uniformed toys pop to attention with a crisp matching salute. They shake hands by the end, the astronaut’s boots bobbing once, fully clear of the strokes.

A warm off-screen voice reads exactly “兵、兵、小小兵” (ㄅㄧㄥ、ㄅㄧㄥ、ㄒㄧㄠˇ ㄒㄧㄠˇ ㄅㄧㄥ) once in clear Taiwanese Mandarin, slowly and distinctly with clear tones and short pauses between utterances, then stops. Keep the soft effects below the voice. Show only 兵 as on-screen text, with no subtitles, logos, watermark, clutter or flashes.
